data.notes: October 2026 is Ibiza’s closing-season month: the first half is dominated by superclub finales, while Akasha, Chinois and Pikes carry the island’s more intimate late-season circuit deeper into the month.

events.title: WooMooN Closing Party
events.summary: WooMooN closes its 2026 Cova Santa season with Jan Blomqvist, Christian Löffler, Deer Jade, Super Flu, Cris 44, Igor Marijuan, Isadora and Rayco Santos. The event is listed for 18:00–05:00.

events.title: Black Coffee / Más Tiempo Closing Party
events.summary: Black Coffee closes his Saturday Hï Ibiza residency in the Theatre with Luciano, Dorian Craft and Djeff; Skepta’s Más Tiempo hosts the Club Room. The source lists the closing party for Saturday, October 3, 2026.

events.title: Solomun+1 Closing Party
events.summary: Solomun closes his long-running Sunday Solomun+1 residency at Pacha Ibiza with Argia listed as the guest. The event page states Sunday, October 4, 2026, 23:00–06:00.

events.title: Pyramid Closing Party
events.summary: Amnesia’s underground Pyramid closing brings Ricardo Villalobos b3b Raresh b3b Franco Cinelli, Seth Troxler, Shanti Celeste and Nina Kraviz. The official Amnesia news page lists the Pyramid closing for October 4.

events.title: Tales of the Unexpected Closing Party
events.summary: The Brothers Grim’s Tales of the Unexpected closes at Akasha with Heidi Lawden & Lovefingers, Visions of Light live, Paul Inflyte, Gerard C, Venus Rollergirl and James Robinson. The listing states Friday, October 9, 2026, 19:00–05:00.

events.title: David Guetta Closing Weekend
events.summary: David Guetta brings a one-night Closing Weekend production to [UNVRS] for his final event of the season. The official [UNVRS] event page confirms the date as October 9, 2026.

events.title: Hï Ibiza Closing Party 2026
events.summary: Hï Ibiza’s final night features Black Coffee, The Martinez Brothers, Paco Osuna, Delilah, Adam Ten b2b Mita Gami and Maz b2b Antdot in the Theatre, plus Skepta’s Más Tiempo in the Club Room. The event page confirms Friday, October 9, 2026, doors 23:00 to close.

events.title: Cova Santa Closing Party
events.summary: Cova Santa closes its 2026 season with Âme live, Red Axes, Trikk, Iban Mendoza, Julya Karma, Magnetizm, Mickey Dastinz, Procer and Victoria Mendoza. The event listing states Friday, October 9, 2026, 16:00–06:00.

events.title: Glitterbox Closing Party
events.summary: Glitterbox closes its first Amnesia Ibiza season with a house and disco-leaning bill including Jorja Smith live PA, Masters At Work, Dimitri From Paris, Natasha Diggs, HoneyLuv and Melvo Baptiste. Amnesia’s calendar lists the closing party on Friday, October 9, 2026.

events.title: Ushuaïa Ibiza Closing Party
events.summary: Ushuaïa closes its open-air season with B2B-heavy house and tech-house sets from Vintage Culture b2b Loco Dice, East End Dubs b2b Hot Since 82, Andrea Oliva b2b Patrick Topping, Nic Fanciulli b2b Butch and more. The official calendar lists Saturday, October 10, 2026, from 13:00.

events.title: [UNVRS] Closing 2026
events.summary: [UNVRS] closes its second Ibiza season with Adriatique, Dennis Cruz, East End Dubs, Mochakk, Rafael, The Martinez Brothers and WhoMadeWho hybrid among the listed artists. The event page confirms Saturday, October 10, 2026.

events.title: Amnesia 50th Closing Festival
events.summary: Amnesia’s 50th-anniversary closing festival lists Joseph Capriati b2b Josh Baker, Enzo Siragusa b2b Saoirse, Deborah De Luca, Nina Kraviz, Klangkuenstler and many more. The official page confirms Saturday, October 10, 2026, with the club opening from 23:00.

events.title: O Beach Closing Party
events.summary: O Beach closes its daytime pool-club season with Joel Corry listed on the bill. The ticket page confirms Sunday, October 11, 2026, 13:00–22:00.

events.title: Music On | Destino Closing Party
events.summary: Marco Carola brings Music On Daytime to Destino Five Ibiza for the venue’s closing party, joined by Luciano, Rossi. and Davide Squillace. The event page confirms Sunday, October 11, 2026, 17:00–23:00.

events.title: Pacha Ibiza Grand Closing Weekend Part 2
events.summary: Pacha Ibiza’s final night of the 2026 season is led by PAWSA with Miguelle & Tons. The official event page confirms Sunday, October 11, 2026, 23:00–06:00.

events.title: Circoloco Closing Party
events.summary: DC10’s official events page lists Circoloco Closing Party for October 12, 2026. The closing is the last scheduled DC10 event shown on the venue’s 2026 page.

events.title: Chinois Ibiza Summer Closing Party
events.summary: Chinois Ibiza’s summer closing party features Guy Gerber, Camilo Franco, Emanuel Satie b2b Baron and Nadja. The listing confirms Saturday, October 17, 2026, 23:30–06:00.

events.title: Pikes House Party Closing
events.summary: Pikes keeps Ibiza’s late-October club culture alive with its House Party Closing, listing Groove Armada DJ set and Bushwacka!. The official Pikes calendar lists the event for Saturday, October 24, 2026, from 21:00.
